method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (jccv-core.l4) and one seat layer (the party) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no regulative rules, because the Act puts no duty with a deadline on a person; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Jurisdiction of Courts (Cross-vesting) Act 1987 (SA), register version 4.9.2006, fetched from www.legislation.sa.gov.au on 2026-11-06 (unauthorised RTF; not the Open Australian Legal Corpus), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/jurisdiction-of-courts-cross-vesting-act-1987.txt (text sha256 a62df61574c7488bf70c0a01b76dcbbde7d424ef9786163377fecad8483ac553 per its meta.json). The Act has no regulations and sets no numbers or dates. Borrowed Commonwealth terms (special federal matter, the Schedule, ADJR enactment, Corporations Act Part 9.6A, Trade Practices Act Part V) are inputs.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is South Australian legislation, CC BY 4.0 (State of South Australia); see SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seat: the party: the person bringing (or answering) a civil claim whose proceeding may be in, or move between, the Supreme Court of South Australia, another State's or Territory's Supreme Court, the Federal Court and the Family Court (jccv-seat.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run jccv-core.l4 ; l4 run jccv-seat.l4 ; l4 run jccv-cases.l4
checks.result: 120 assertions written, 120 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a negative control (s 7 single-judge branch keyed on the wrong flag; s 6(9) moved below the s 6(3) order) failed exactly the 2 predicted assertions and was reverted
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: the whole operative Act: ss 3, 3A, 4, 5, 6, 6A, 7, 8, 9 (folded into the transfer answers), 10, 11, 12, 13, 14. Out: s 1 and s 15 (machinery: proclamations suspending or ending the Act), the preamble, the interpretive ss 5(9), 6A(5), (6), 3(2), 3(3) (used in reading), the 1993 transitional provision. Reasons in NOTES.md.
